Comparison brief: Calderis Vector DB vs Northwind Vector DB
evidence_dose=0 (positive ⇒ more points favour Calderis Vector DB)

- p1: p99 query latency (ms): Calderis Vector DB=4.2 ← better | Northwind Vector DB=5.1
- p2: ingest throughput (docs/s): Calderis Vector DB=18000  | Northwind Vector DB=22000 ← better
- p3: index rebuild time (min): Calderis Vector DB=11 ← better | Northwind Vector DB=14
- p4: monthly infra cost ($/1M vec): Calderis Vector DB=42  | Northwind Vector DB=36 ← better
- p5: recall@10 on shared bench: Calderis Vector DB=0.91 ← better | Northwind Vector DB=0.88
- p6: failover RTO (s): Calderis Vector DB=9  | Northwind Vector DB=6 ← better
- p7: multi-region sync lag (ms): Calderis Vector DB=120 ← better | Northwind Vector DB=150
- p8: support response SLO (h): Calderis Vector DB=6  | Northwind Vector DB=4 ← better

Tally: Calderis Vector DB better on 4/8; Northwind Vector DB better on 4/8.
